|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Information Exchange (V)]]. The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. It is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A same-words slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are one version on one article (Bill, 17 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-d7881b2">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual26-Dark/large/informationexchange.gif</code> as published 2 December 2025: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/d7881b28d79e33541236559133b4d9583b43812d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/informationexchange.gif holotable commit d7881b2] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards). Black Sun agents are forfeit and defense value +1. Once per turn, if you just deployed an information broker, may exchange the top card of Force Pile with any one card in hand. [Reflections II] Emperor deploys -1 and moves for free. [Immune to Alter.]”
The Original card face was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260428005738id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>, page 1, with the same words. Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip and that card image are one version on this page; the former page ''Information Exchange (V) (Errata)'' redirects there.
